```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(VennDiagram)
library(ggvenn)
library(ggbreak)
library(BSgenome)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0)

source('../CRISPR-KO-library-refinement-pipeline/sgRNA_library_refinement_pipeline_functions.R')
source("./00_CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R")
```

# Import sgRNA library and sgRNA log-fold-change data

```{r}
avana_library_meyers <- read_tsv("../CRISPR-KO-library-refinement-pipeline/public_crispr_library/avana_library.tsv", col_names = FALSE)
colnames(avana_library_meyers) <- c("sgrna", "spacer", "gene")

avana_lfc <- read_csv("./sgrna_logfc/AvanaLogfoldChange.csv")
names(avana_lfc)[1] <- "spacer"

# left join

avana_sgrna_lfc <- avana_lfc %>%
  left_join(avana_library_meyers, join_by("spacer")) %>%
  relocate(sgrna, .before = spacer) %>%
  relocate(gene, .after = spacer) %>%
  arrange(gene)


```
